content.short: Kani Token is a Cardano Native token and cNFT project.
content.description:
The Logo for Kani Token ($Kani) was inspired by one of the original characters from the 80's Arcade Game called: Space Invaders . The character chosen from the game was the Medium Invader/Crab Invader/ or Kani in Japanese . Kani is made of pixels 👾, and it is one of the most recognizable and beloved gaming characters in history even to this day. The year 2023 will be the 45th anniversary of the original game and we are going to make it memorable for our supporters. As of now (pre-cNFT release) $Kani is used as a reward for staking with qualified pools (see website for more info). Once both Tier1 and Tier2 cNFTs are minted, it is going to be distributed as a reward token to our cNFT HODLers. Our Future Plans will include , but not limited to: cNFT Staking to earn limited edition cNFT(s). Strategic Partnerships. Collabs with other Cardano Projects •Exchange (DEX/CEX) Listings. Several Giveaways We will also Initiate a buyback program after the Original game’s anniversary next year. In case anyone decides they no longer wish to keep their cNFT(s), whether they minted it originally or purchased it at a later time, we will have a buyback program for them, and reimburse them the original minting cost(s).
